item.title: Portrait Cut for Two Speakers

turns.text: Turn this into a 9:16 vertical clip. Show the man when he asks his question, then the woman when she answers, with each centred while talking. Keep all 10 seconds and the original audio. No captions.

item.tests: Tests speaker-aware portrait reframing of a two-person conversation without losing either speaking turn.

answer_sheet.Source and speakers: Use talk-two.mp4. The man asks the question and the woman answers.
answer_sheet.Layout and transitions: Centre the current speaker in a full-frame portrait crop; a clean cut at the speaker change is fine.
answer_sheet.Size and duration: 9:16 vertical, all 10 seconds; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Audio and text: Preserve the original conversation and sound, with no captions or added text.

must_haves: The output is a 9:16 portrait edit of the attached office conversation.
The man is centred and his face is fully visible during his question.
The woman is centred and her face is fully visible during her answer.
Both speaking turns remain in their original order, with the full 10 seconds and original audio in sync.
The image is not stretched and contains no added captions.

dialog.agent:
This needs a **speaker-following crop**, not AI regeneration: a 9:16 frame centred on the man during his question, then on the woman during her answer, preserving all 10 seconds and the original audio, with no captions.

The connected tools don’t offer precise cropping or speaker-based reframing. I can’t reliably make this edit without risking changes to the footage or audio, so I haven’t generated a modified clip.
dialog.why: It says the connected tools cannot perform precise cropping or speaker-based reframing, so it has not produced the requested edit.
dialog.user: Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.

dialog.agent:
Free settings still don’t provide speaker-following cropping. The available option would **AI-regenerate the footage**, which may change the faces, dialogue or audio rather than preserve your original.

Are you okay with that approximation at **480p**, or is keeping the original footage and audio exact essential?
dialog.why: It asks the user to choose between an AI-regenerated approximation at 480p and preserving the original footage and audio exactly, then waits.
dialog.user: Keeping the original footage and audio exact is essential.

turns.agent:
Understood—**no AI regeneration**. I can’t make this exact edit with the connected tools, so I haven’t changed your file or spent generation credits.

Use a standard video editor to:
- Set the canvas to **9:16**.
- Keep the full **10-second clip** and original audio unchanged.
- Centre the crop on the man during his question, then switch to the woman during her answer.
- Add no captions.

Only the framing should change—not the footage or sound.
